name: a_T_fence
caption: Gross projected fence height for one wind direction.

name: b_M_fence
caption: First moment of the one-face gross projected fence area about the cap reference.

name: z_eff
caption: Equivalent height of the transverse fence resultant above the cap reference.

name: w_fence
caption: Horizontal fence force per foot of bridge.

name: F_fence
caption: Total transverse fence force delivered to the intermediate pier.

name: M_fence
caption: Fence moment about the longitudinal axis through the cap reference.

name: F_V_fence
caption: Vertical fence component in the global projected-load model.

name: F_c_III
caption: Total Strength III concrete superstructure force delivered across the bridge to the pier.

name: M_c_III
caption: Strength III moment caused by the concrete superstructure force acting above the cap.

name: F_cap_T_III
caption: Total across-bridge force at the cap reference: Strength III, LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

name: M_cap_L_III
caption: Total moment about the longitudinal axis at the cap reference: Strength III, LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

name: F_c_SI
caption: Total Service I concrete superstructure force delivered across the bridge to the pier.

name: M_c_SI
caption: Service I moment caused by the concrete superstructure force acting above the cap.

name: F_cap_T_SI
caption: Total across-bridge force at the cap reference: Service I, LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

name: M_cap_L_SI
caption: Total moment about the longitudinal axis at the cap reference: Service I, LRFD 13.8.2 fence load.

name: L_span_max
caption: Maximum individual span used to qualify the LRFD simplified wind method.

name: DC_span
caption: Individual span length / 150 ft limit of the simplified method

name: DC_height
caption: Bridge height above low ground / 33 ft limit of the simplified method

name: Check_simplified
expr: If(And(L_span_max <= 150 ft, H_bridge <= 33 ft), "✓ PASS", "⊗ FAIL")
caption: Live check that the bridge satisfies both LRFD 3.8.1.2.3a limits for the simplified wind components.

name: F_cap_L_III
caption: Simultaneous longitudinal cap force: Strength III simplified wind case.

name: M_cap_T_III
caption: Moment about the transverse axis associated with the Strength III longitudinal component.

name: F_cap_L_SI
caption: Simultaneous longitudinal cap force: Service I simplified wind case.

name: M_cap_T_SI
caption: Moment about the transverse axis associated with the Service I longitudinal component.

name: q_III
caption: Strength III wind-pressure term before the direct-substructure drag multiplier.

name: q_SI
caption: Service I wind-pressure term before the direct-substructure drag multiplier.

name: p_sub_III
caption: Strength III pressure on the pier wall and cap themselves.

name: p_sub_SI
caption: Service I pressure on the pier wall and cap themselves.

name: F_wall_T_III
caption: Strength III wind force acting directly on the pier’s transverse projected face.

name: F_wall_L_III
caption: Strength III wind force acting directly normal to the broad pier-wall face.

name: F_wall_T_SI
caption: Service I wind force acting directly on the pier’s transverse projected face.

name: F_wall_L_SI
caption: Service I wind force acting directly normal to the broad pier-wall face.

name: Check_geometry
expr: If(And(h_f > 0 ft, R_f > 0 ft, h_tan >= 0 ft, z_base >= 0 ft, L_trib > 0 ft), "✓ PASS", "⊗ FAIL")
caption: Check the basic dimensions used by the prescribed fence load model.

name: Check_balance
expr: If(And(Abs(M_fence - F_fence*z_eff) < 0.000001 kip*ft, Abs(F_cap_T_III - F_c_III - F_fence) < 0.000001 kip, Abs(M_cap_L_III - M_c_III - M_fence) < 0.000001 kip*ft, Abs(F_cap_T_SI - F_c_SI - F_fence) < 0.000001 kip, Abs(M_cap_L_SI - M_c_SI - M_fence) < 0.000001 kip*ft), "✓ PASS", "⊗ FAIL")
caption: Check the fence resultant and cap-reference totals.
